Frequently asked questions

What is a fractional expansion director?

A part-time Expansion or Project Director with the experience of a full-time one. The fractional model gives access to that level with the flexibility and cost of an external collaborator, without the overhead of a full-time director.

Who is DIRIGE for?

For QSR or retail chains of 10–60 units, expanding restaurant groups, hotel operators, developers with singular projects, operators entering new markets and investors transforming assets.

What are the time commitment and duration?

The monthly retainer is 20–40 h/month depending on phase, with a renewable quarterly minimum. A typical project cycle is 6–12 weeks, formalised through a commercial services contract with SLA, dedication and defined deliverables.

What does directing an opening or construction project include?

From investment decision to handover and go-live: technical feasibility, licenses and permits, execution project, tendering, construction and supervision, FF&E and opening, with CAPEX control, schedule and reporting to investor or board.

Running an expansion this year?

Commercial services contract with SLA, dedication and defined deliverables. Typical cycle: 6–12 weeks.
